status: CONTROLLED RECONSTRUCTION — NOT A CERTIFIED COURT DOCKET
purpose: Reconstruct Concurso 36/2012 as closed procedural families so each material party filing is paired to receipt, court/LAJ act, service, review/appeal, finality and implementation before prosecutorial conclusions are upgraded.
completion_rule: No material party filing is complete without a verified court-channel receipt or an explicit receipt gap.
No material court/LAJ act is complete without the signed instrument or authentic notification metadata, service status and operative effect.
Every review, reposicion, apelacion or queja must be linked to the decision attacked and to its own outcome/finality status.
Every dispositive act affecting title, possession, credit, testimonios or implementation must be linked to the downstream deed, registry, accounting or operational consequence where applicable.
Absence from the controlled corpus means response-not-located, never nonexistence.
LexNET IDs and document hashes are primary dedupe keys; filenames, forwards and email subjects are not unique procedural records.

closed_points: LPB and Aweswell both filed appeals against the 15-Oct-2021 Autos after the 26-Jan-2022 clarification orders.
The 9-Mar-2022 judge-signed Auto inadmitted both appeals and expressly directed a queja route.
Aweswell filed a queja with the Audiencia Provincial and separately notified the Mercantile Court.
The Mercantile Court's LAJ recorded both queja notices on 4-Apr-2022 under registration numbers 2275 and 2314/2022.
On 26-Apr-2022 the LAJ issued adverse decisions on the 11-Feb and 14-Feb procedural/testimonio/finality challenges.
open_points: Locate and control LPB's own recurso de queja receipt and principal document.
Identify the Audiencia Provincial proceeding number(s), admission decision(s), section, service and final outcome for both quejas.
Control the exact 11-Feb-2022 and 14-Feb-2022 DIORs and the testimonios issued under them, including the wording on purpose, recipient and finality.
Determine whether LPB or Aweswell filed direct revision against either 26-Apr-2022 Decreto and, if so, pair the result.
Bind this family to the 21-Feb deed and 20-Apr registry/title implementation chronology finca-by-finca; current date ordering itself requires careful reconciliation rather than assumption.

publication_rule: Do not silently promote candidate records into the canonical denominator. Publish supplements with provenance, dedupe keys and open pairings; create canonical v2 only after cross-supplement deduplication.
